Committee: Veterans and Military Affairs
Sponsor: Jones
Analyst: Daniel Davenport
Date: 01/27/2021
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 16 as introduced would require the Alabama Department of Education (SDE) to establish and award an alternative teaching certificate to certain retired members of the United States Armed Forces. This would increase administrative costs of the Department by a small undetermined amount which could be offset, in part or in whole, by application fee receipts collected for the issuance of certificates.
Tom Butler, Chairperson
Veterans and Military Affairs

Committee: Governmental Affairs
Sponsor: Butler
Analyst: Julie Knight
Date: 02/19/2021
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 111 as introduced allows tax land sales to occur on the premises of, or within, the courthouse or courthouse annex of the county and also allows the judge of probate to permit a designee to attend the sales on their behalf.
This bill is remedial, curative, and retroactive and will not directly affect state or local funding.
Jimmy Holley, Chairperson
Governmental Affairs

Committee: Judiciary

Date: 03/05/2021
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 111 as passed the Senate allows tax land sales to occur on the premises of, or within, the courthouse or courthouse annex of the county and also allows the judge of probate to permit a designee to attend the sales on their behalf.
This bill is remedial, curative, and retroactive and will not directly affect state or local funding.
Jim Hill, Chair
Judiciary
